# SOLARSYS LLP — Clean Energy & Green Infrastructure Solutions

> SOLARSYS (LLP) is Bhopal's premier clean energy engineering and solar EPC company, specializing in rooftop and ground-mounted solar systems, wind, geothermal, biomass & biogas, and advanced battery energy storage systems (BESS). Headquartered in Arera Colony, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India, SOLARSYS delivers turnkey green energy infrastructure nationwide and worldwide.

## Core Documentation
- [Comprehensive Knowledge Base & Technical Specs](https://solarsysllp.com/llms-full.txt): In-depth engineering specifications, government subsidy guides, technical datasheets, and company credentials.
- [XML Sitemap](https://solarsysllp.com/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable XML route directory.

## Clean Energy Portfolio & Services
- [Solar Energy Solutions (Rooftop & Ground EPC)](https://solarsysllp.com/#services): Residential, commercial complexes, industrial plants, and utility infrastructure with MPMKVVCL net-metering synchronization.
- [Wind Energy Systems](https://solarsysllp.com/#services): Clean kinetic power generation, wind resource feasibility studies, and solar-wind hybrid grid tie-ins.
- [Geothermal Energy Infrastructure](https://solarsysllp.com/#services): Subterranean earth heat extraction for continuous 24/7/365 baseload clean power.
- [Biomass & Biogas Power Systems](https://solarsysllp.com/#services): Converting agricultural residues and organic waste into clean renewable electricity and bio-CNG.
- [Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)](https://solarsysllp.com/#services): High-cycle Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) energy storage and IoT cloud microgrid telemetry.
- [Turnkey EPC & Commissioning](https://solarsysllp.com/#services): End-to-end engineering, DISCOM liaison, subsidy documentation, and 25-year lifecycle maintenance.

## Bhopal Solar Hub & Government Subsidies
- [PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana & Bhopal Hub](https://solarsysllp.com/#bhopal-solar): Direct central subsidies up to ₹78,000 for residential rooftop solar in Bhopal, MPMKVVCL bi-directional net-metering approvals, and 40% commercial accelerated tax depreciation.

## Core Products & Systems
- [High-Efficiency Solar Systems](https://solarsysllp.com/#products): Tier-1 Monocrystalline PERC solar panels (450W - 550W+, 21.5% efficiency), residential and commercial rooftop arrays.
- [Integrated Renewable Power Systems](https://solarsysllp.com/#products): Hybrid on-grid/off-grid inverters (dual MPPT, 98.2% efficiency), solar water pumps (0.5 HP - 10 HP), and solar street lighting.
- [Energy Storage & Automation Solutions](https://solarsysllp.com/#products): LiFePO4 battery modules (5.12 kWh - 10.24 kWh, 6000+ deep cycles) and smart IoT cloud telemetry.

## Regional EPC Showcase (Bhopal & Central India)
- [Featured Projects](https://solarsysllp.com/#projects): Luxury residence 15 kW in Arera Colony Bhopal, Mandideep Industrial Solar 1.2 MW captive plant, Govindpura Commercial Complex 350 kW, and Hoshangabad Road institutional campus 500 kW.
